turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Why did my son find out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, before anyone called me?
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.

"The end of it." Your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything, and Turnitin's guide says the same thing; I have both printed in my bag. So either you have something else, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal at 4:35.
I don't need more proof than that.
"Don't need more proof." I'm writing that down, Hale, word for word. Is anything on Owen's record right now, yes or no?
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
Unlike some people. Is that my son you mean, or me? Choose carefully, Hale, because that sentence is going in my letter to the principal tonight.

Then you've decided without hearing Owen and without calling me, and you've just told me there's nothing else. I want the decision, the date you entered it, and the name of whoever approved it, in an email by tomorrow morning. And after this I'm going straight to the principal's office.
